### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set change: three paths-filter lists widen; nothing else moves.** The `filter` job's `core:`, `docs:` and `ui:` lists gain rows; no job, `if:`, `needs:`, output expression, step, check-run name or trigger changes. Right — the diff is additive rows and comments inside the `filters:` block scalar only.
- **Per-path accept set, judged against the tree, not the PR body's table:**
  - `.github/actions/setup-workspace/**` joins `core` and `docs`. Every `uses: ./.github/actions/setup-workspace` in `ci.yml` is in a job gated by `core` (test-plan 587, test 815, temporal-conformance 2094, dogfood 2372, dogfood-verify 2587, build-core 2774) or by `docs` (build-docs 3073). No UI job uses it. Right.
  - `.github/actions/setup-pnpm/**` joins `core`, `docs` and `ui`. The seven `ui`-gated jobs `uses:` it directly (3307, 3443, 3724, 3963, 4281, 4534, 4709); `setup-workspace/action.yml` line 85 calls it, so every `core`/`docs` job runs it too. Right.
  - `.nvmrc` joins `core`, `docs` and `ui`. `setup-workspace/action.yml` line 82 hands it to actions/setup-node as `node-version-file`; each of the seven UI jobs has its own setup-node step reading the same file (3304, 3440, 3721, 3960, 4278, 4531, 4706). Right.
  - `.github/actions/half-state-patrol/**` joins no list. `.github/actions` holds exactly three actions at the head; this one is used only by `half-state-patrol.yml:277`, never by a `ci.yml` job. Declining the `.github/actions/**` glob is right: it would start the core, docs and UI pipelines on a diff no `ci.yml` job reads.
- **`crosspkg`, `ui_consumers`, `ui_tree` untouched.** Right: `crosspkg` gates `test` alone, ORed with `core` (line 721), which now covers the paths; every UI job's `if:` reads `ui` OR `ui_consumers`, so `ui` suffices; `ui_tree` is a presence probe, not a paths list.
- **Matching semantics need no local probe.** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` already sits in `core` and `docs`, and `.github/workflows/**` in `ui`; this PR is a `ci.yml`-only diff, and its head started Plan Test Core shards, Test Core, Build Core, Build Docs and all seven UI jobs (check-runs). That is a live proof that dot-directory literals and globs match under the pinned dorny/paths-filter v4.0.3. `.github/actions/NAME/**` is the same shape and `.nvmrc` is a root-level literal.
- **Required contexts.** No check-run is renamed or regated. All ten required contexts are `success` on the head: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI. The `filter` job itself is `success`, so the edited `filters:` block parsed.
- **Premise re-checked on `origin/main` 85663a57.** The filter block (lines 268-520 of the main copy) carries no non-comment `actions/` or `nvmrc` entry; the blind spot the card measured is still open on main. Right.
- **Public surface.** None; a workflow-internal scheduling change publishes nothing.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

The diff is one workflow file. No package, schema, skill or export moves, so no changeset is owed and the `skip-changeset` label is the correct carrier (Check Changeset `success` on the head). The PR body's `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim (6506106457) and match what the diff publishes: nothing. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` — none to answer.
- **NOT MEASURED locally, answered by the head's check-runs:** `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-action-forward-parity.test.ts` did not load in the dev's worktree; Test UI (all 16 shards and the aggregate) is `success` on the head. The four Build Core guards exited 3 locally (no `dist`); Build Core is `success` on the head. Both answered.
- **Out-of-scope 1 — parity gate header names setup-pnpm as "today's one" local composite action.** Read at `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` header: the bound ("a local composite action a step `uses:` is not followed") still holds with two actions; `setup-workspace` names no repository script either. Stale prose, no gate effect, outside the `hits`. Answered; should-fix in a later tooling PR, not here.
- **Out-of-scope 2 — root `package.json` `packageManager` field reaches `core` but not `ui`.** Confirmed in the tree: `setup-pnpm/action.yml` line 14 reads `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/package.json`'s `packageManager`; the `ui:` list carries no `package.json` row. A gap of the card's class, narrower than it: on such a diff the `core` jobs run the same `setup-pnpm`, so the new pnpm is exercised on the PR; what is not exercised is the `ui/` install under it. Escalated: this deserves its own card (it is a reproducible scheduling gap, which Prime Directive #10 says to file, not only note). Not a defect of this PR.
- **Out-of-scope 3 — S2 and the Live E2E UI reader routed to #27619.** Verified against the tree: the string `root build inputs` is absent from `ci.yml` on `origin/main`, and `live-e2e-ui`'s `if:` (line 4509) does not read `core`. So the parenthetical the card's S2 wants amended does not exist in the tree this PR edits, and an S1 note that omits Live E2E UI is the true reading of main. Boundary: the PR says `Fixes #27673` while card Wanted 3 and the S2 half of acceptance item 2 ride an open draft; the card carries no comment recording that routing (the dev report cites a seat instruction at 19:18Z that is not on the card). Should-fix for the seat, not for the file: record the routing on the card before the `Fixes` keyword closes it, or carry the card as `Part-of`.

### ④ Design judgment

`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the one `hits` file, judged against card #27673's acceptance and the code it cites.

**Acceptance 1 — a diff confined to the actions or `.nvmrc` starts the jobs that run them. Holds.** The per-path walk in ① covers every `uses: ./` and every `node-version-file` in the file; no `ci.yml` job that runs any of the three paths is gated by a list the path did not join. Attempts to break it:

- *A path that should start a job but does not.* None found. Every setup-workspace job is `core`- or `docs`-gated; every setup-pnpm job is `ui`-gated (OR `ui_consumers`, which never matters since `ui` matches); no job is gated by `crosspkg` or `ui_consumers` alone. The full-battery jobs (temporal-conformance, dogfood, dogfood-verify, ui-published-artifacts) read the same outputs with an event guard on top, so a push to main confined to these paths runs them too.
- *A required check that would stop reporting.* No job, name, `needs:`, `if:` or trigger changed; no new `paths:` on any `on:` key (the workflow-level triggers are untouched, so the `filter` job still runs on every PR). Ten of ten required contexts `success` on the head.
- *A filter that now starts everything.* The only new patterns are two directory-scoped globs and one root literal. The `.github/actions/**` form was declined with the reason written beside the rows, and that reason is true in the tree (the third action is run by no `ci.yml` job).
- *Comment placement inside the block scalar.* Same form as the file's existing commented rows; the `filter` check-run concluded `success` and the gated jobs started, so dorny parsed the block.
- *merge_group.* `docs`, `core` and `crosspkg` are forced `'true'` there regardless; `ui` reads the queue diff, where the new rows match the same way. The `ui:` comment says exactly this.
- *Over-scheduling cost.* A diff confined to `.nvmrc` or `setup-pnpm` now starts core, docs and UI. Those are precisely the jobs that consume the path, so this is the card's demand met, not a widening.

**Acceptance 2, S1 — reader note on the `core` output. Holds.** Every reader of `needs.filter.outputs.core` in the file: 569 test-plan, 721 test (ORed with `crosspkg`), 2035 temporal-conformance, 2353 dogfood, 2576 dogfood-verify, 2763 build-core. The note names exactly those six, in the sibling `crosspkg` comment's style. Nit, neither must- nor should-fix: the three full-battery jobs also run on `workflow_dispatch`, which "push / schedule" elides while the file's own TWO SPEEDS header names it.

**Acceptance 2, S2 — the `live-e2e-ui` parenthetical. Nothing to judge in this tree.** The text does not exist on main (③). The note that omits Live E2E UI as a `core` reader is correct for main.

**Acceptance 3 — `check:ci-filter-parity` and `check:pm-expected-skips` stay green. Holds**, and no tooling row was owed: both run inside Lint & Repo Gates (`success`); the parity gate's leftover rule does not judge root-level files or pattern entries (its header, "Root-level files and pattern entries are not judged that way"), and the expected-skips roster is derived from each job's `if:`, which did not change.

**Comment truth in the new rows.** "each one starts with `./.github/actions/setup-workspace`, which calls `./.github/actions/setup-pnpm` and hands actions/setup-node `.nvmrc`" matches `setup-workspace/action.yml` lines 80-85. "`half-state-patrol` is no step of any job in this file" is true. "The `docs` and `ui` lists carry the rows their own jobs run" is true (docs: all three; ui: the two its jobs run).

**Observation, widened, not a finding on the hit.** Five other `pull_request`-paths-filtered workflows that run `setup-workspace` (shard-timings-refresh, checklist-status, os-create-smoke, validate-deps, spec-liveness-check) name neither `.github/actions` nor `.nvmrc` in their `paths:`. None is a required context and the card is `ci.yml`'s filter job; a lane card, not this PR.

**Findings.** Must-fix: none. Should-fix (none blocks this file): (a) record the S2 / Live E2E UI routing on the card before `Fixes` closes it, or carry the card as `Part-of`; (b) file the root `package.json` → `ui` gap as its own card; (c) refresh the parity gate header's "today's one" bound in a tooling PR.
